_comment: The release the Talos overlay deploys, recorded so a digest can be tied to a tag offline.
A registry tag can be checked against nothing without the network, and a digest is opaque:
this file is the committed link between them. It is updated in the same change as
fails when the three disagree. Values are index digests from the v<release> GitHub
release / GHCR multi-arch index, not per-platform manifests.
